item.title: Lewis Acid-Base Regulated Novel Eutectic Electrolyte of 1,4-Butane Sultone and LiTFSI Enables High-Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries via F/S-Rich Interphases

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a novel deep eutectic electrolyte from 1,4-butane sultone and LiTFSI, regulated by Lewis acid-base interactions. Its significance lies in enabling high-voltage lithium metal batteries through the formation of fluorine- and sulfur-rich interphases, which suppress oxidative decomposition and extend cycling life.

item.title: Site‐Preferential Trace Phosphorus Substitution Accelerates and Stabilizes the Activation of Lithium‐Rich Cathode Materials
item.description:
جانشینی ناچیز فسفر در جایگاه‌های خاص کاتد غنی از لیتیوم، فعال‌سازی جزء Li2MnO3 را تسریع و پایداری ساختاری و ظرفیت ۲۷۰ mAh/g را حفظ می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Trace P substitution in Li-rich Mn-based cathodes preferentially occupies Li-layer sites near Ni, modifying Li-slab and Ni─O/O electronic environments. This enables faster, more stable monoclinic Li₂MnO₃ activation with self-relaxing lattice response, delivering 273.1 mAh g⁻¹ at cycle 50 and 270.5 mAh g⁻¹ after 300 cycles—suppressing irreversible distortion, oxygen degradation, and voltage decay.
🏷 lithium-rich cathode · phosphorus substitution · oxygen redox · layered oxide · voltage decay
